uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

116-5921-5970-8296.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kiora's Follower.
Activate one of the Kiora's Follower tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kiora's Follower token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1306-4779-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1306-4779-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mana Crypt by paying its mana cost.
When Mana Crypt enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Mana Crypt, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mana Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

640-4279-6112--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
640-4279-6112--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester, Fumulus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Fumulus ability, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

132-549-3941-4687.easyPrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-549-3941-4687.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Coveted Jewel's ability by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G/U}.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.

549-1651-4659-5261-8117.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting Raise the Alarm without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Raise the Alarm, creating two creature tokens that are also artifacts due to Biotransference.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping both creature tokens, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing one creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped tokens, you may sacrifice any number of them to add infinite colorless mana.

3110-4067-5078-7914.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Iron Lad.
Activate Iron Lad by tapping it, revealing Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library and then drawing it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Council of the Absolute.
Repeat

2341-2495-7826.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two Foods.
2341-2495-7826.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Bag End Banquet and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Bag End Banquet by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Bag End Banquet and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Bag End Banquet and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

443-1580-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2730-5147-5987.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Angel of Indemnity
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

104-1308-2034-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-1308-2034-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

5344-6349-6869.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell from anywhere but your hand this turn.
5344-6349-6869.description:
Cast Aang by paying its mana cost.
When Aang enters, it triggers, exiling Charismatic Conqueror.
Cast Charismatic Conqueror from exile by paying {2}.
Charismatic Conqueror's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy it.
Resolve the opponent's copy of Charismatic Conqueror, and then resolve your copy of Charismatic Conqueror.
When your Charismatic Conqueror token enters the battlefield,  the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to tap your Charismatic Conqueror token.
Resolve the original Charismatic Conqueror spell.
When the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the opponent's Vampire token enters the battlefield, both Charismatic Conquerors you control trigger, causing you to create at least one 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When your Vampire token enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the Vampire token, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Repeat from step 9.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5663-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cayth.
When Cayth dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cayth enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

147-2921-6817.description:
Cast Presumed Dead by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Presumed Dead, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Presumed Dead.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from step 5.

2173-2921-3661-5220.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

539-5649-5686-6517.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

413-1202-1737-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Myr Moonvessel.
When Myr Moonvessel enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel and tapping it.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, Myr Moonvessel and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Myr Moonvessel trigger, adding {C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1494-6434.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain 5 or more life each turn.
1494-6434.description:
Gain 5 or more life.
At the beginning of your end step, Betor triggers, putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2103-3277-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Izzet Chronarch each turn.
2103-3277-6122.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Izzet Chronarch by paying its mana cost.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Izzet Chronarch from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

539-4186-6081.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying {2}{G}.
When Scurry Oak enters the battlefield, Black Panther triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak, as it is a Forest land due to Ashaya.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Black Panther triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak, as it is a Forest land due to Ashaya.
Repeat from step 3.

3197-5231-5445.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Herd Baloth.
3197-5231-5445.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
3197-5231-5445.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Beast, adding {R}.
When the Beast dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

1438-4944.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one creature card in a graveyard.
1438-4944.description:
Activate Eater of the Dead by paying {0}, targeting any creature card in a graveyard.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1020-2034-3689-4947.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding {C}{C}.
Workshop Assistant dies, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Thopter and Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Myr Retriever dies, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {3}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

3525-3990.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Incubation Druid.
Incubation Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Incubation Druid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control a land that can produce {U}.
3525-3990.description:
Activate Incubation Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Incubation Druid.
Repeat.

3807-4762.notablePrerequisites: Swift Reconfiguration attached to Devoted Druid.
3807-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping itself.
Repeat.

598-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken Zombie or a nontoken creature with changeling with mana value one or less.
Liliana has at least three loyalty counters on it.
598-4050.description:
Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a nontoken Zombie or nontoken creature with changeling with mana value one or less, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

738-3370-3652-5256.description:
Sacrifice Ornithopter to Altar of Dementia.
Butcher of Malakir triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Ornithopter to your hand.
Resolve Altar of Dementia's ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
